headline: Impeachment Day 16 Focuses on Disbursing Witnesses and Confidential-Fund Records
seoTitle: Impeachment Day 16: Disbursing Witnesses Testify | FMB News
seoDescription: The August 17 impeachment proceedings focused on testimony and records concerning the handling of 2022 confidential funds.
deck: The prosecution questioned personnel tied to disbursement records while the defense challenged the interpretation and use of the documents.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The Senate sitting as an impeachment court continued Day 16 proceedings on August 17, with the prosecution presenting witnesses connected to disbursement and accounting records for 2022 confidential funds.
The FMB News midday brief said questioning centered on cash advances, vouchers and liquidation records, while defense counsel challenged the prosecution's interpretation of the paper trail.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The hearing forms part of the fourth week of the vice presidential impeachment trial. Testimony about financial records is being tested through direct and cross-examination rather than treated as established fact merely because a party presents it.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: The evidentiary weight of authenticated records and witness testimony may shape how senator-judges assess disputed confidential-fund transactions.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch for further cross-examination, evidentiary rulings and additional documentary or rebuttal witnesses.
